notes.title: Passport collected

notes.itemTitle: Close the KITAS and withdraw BPJS
notes.title: Ascentium replied at last
notes.body: Chitra wrote this morning: InCorp has rebranded to Ascentium, and an email migration is why nothing arrived since October. The sales order and a document checklist are attached, and to start they need your Jakarta departure ticket, your boarding pass and a termination letter from Locus. - The letter is the slow part, so ask Jishnu for it now.
